books.title: Sample - Run populate_library.py to download texts
books.author: Borges
books.content:
This is a placeholder. To populate your library:

1. Run: python scripts/populate_library.py --source all
2. Run: python scripts/build_static.py

This will download texts from:
- MIT Internet Classics Archive
- Project Gutenberg
- Sacred Texts Archive
- Fordham Medieval Sourcebook
- Princeton Dante Project
- Marxists Internet Archive
- Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy
- Wikisource
- Bartleby

Then the docs/data/library.json will contain all your books.
